title: Launching Free Fire Esports Vietnam on TikTok with >1B views
thumb_alt: Free Fire Esports Vietnam 2020 final, ranked #1 on YouTube Gaming trending

metrics.label: total views, first esports hashtag challenge in Vietnam

challenge: TikTok was gaining ground in Vietnam and matched the Free Fire audience, but Free Fire Esports had no channel there and no esports hashtag challenge existed in the market.
actions: Spotted TikTok’s fit with the target audience, launched the channel in September 2020, and partnered with TikTok on #khoanhkhacesports hashtag challenge, producing 60+ videos per month
results: Esports first-ever +1 billion views hashtag challenge on TikTok
